To install ReMe, you need Python 3.11 or newer. You can install it from pip using the command `pip install "reme-ai[core]"` or from source by cloning the repository, navigating to the ReMe directory, and running `pip install -e ".[core]"`. For advanced configurations, you can set environment variables for LLM-driven memory evolution and embedding retrieval. To start the ReMe service, use the command `reme start`, and the default service address is `127.0.0.1:2333`. If a different port is needed, specify it with `reme start service.port=8181`.

mkdir -p .reme docker compose up --build -d
